name: Chioma
blurb: A corporate professional navigating controlling pressure at home and microaggressions at work.

nodes.text: Morning commute in Abuja. Ngozi checks her phone before entering the office.
Good morning! Are we still talking on Sunday?
Four doors she can knock on. Each response closes tighter.

doors.label: Sister
doors.text: I'm worried about you, but I'm too far away in Port Harcourt.

doors.label: HR Department
doors.text: This is a personal domestic matter outside office jurisdiction.

doors.label: Pastor
doors.text: Endure and pray. Marriage requires sacrifice from a woman.

doors.label: Colleague / Friend
doors.text: At least he provides well and cares. Don't provoke him.
